status: Exploratory protocol written after an initial corpus scan; not preregistered or held out
grouping: Prefix of local id before period; require consistent nonempty CISI identifier within group
candidate_selection: Every group containing literal three-digit tokens 700 and 840
marker_selection: Exactly one occurrence of each marker, on different recorded faces
strict_quality: Existing parse_lipi filters applied to both marker faces
sensitivity_quality: Same filters, allowing L/R as well as R/L; additive flanking sums are direction invariant
numeric_runs: Maximal contiguous runs immediately flanking each marker, in literal file order; no skipping intervening signs
main_model: Each long or stacked stroke contributes L; each short stroke contributes S; each W900 contributes v. Add both flanks and require equal sums across marker faces.
stacked_sensitivity: Each stacked stroke contributes one instead of L; all other contributions unchanged
source_relation: A deliberately narrow extension of Figure 16's proposed equalities, not an implementation of all context-dependent rules in Fuls (2020)
limitations: Neither numerical roles nor equality or commensurate units are established
Remaining signs are explicitly retained but not interpreted
Unrecognized neighboring signs stop extraction; this does not establish they are nonnumerical
Local face and sign identities have not been verified from artifact photographs
Repeated patterns and the source-construction example are not independent validation
